objects.name: U
objects.description: A type that contains all types, including itself

morphisms.name: code
morphisms.description: Every type in U₀ has a code in U

morphisms.name: decode
morphisms.description: Every code decodes to a type in U₀

morphisms.name: self
morphisms.description: U contains a code for itself: self : 1 → U

axioms.name: decode_code
axioms.description: decode(code(A)) = A for all types A

axioms.name: code_decode
axioms.description: code(decode(u)) = u for all u : U
